verdicts.reason: The two are almost the same layout, and both have the same problems. The GLACIER wordmark floats on its own to the right of the circle. A large empty area sits beside the product, and the left edges don't line up: the headline and body copy start at about x=254, the badges at about 303–310, and the CTA at about 373. The result is a ragged staircase that pushes the CTA off-axis instead of a clean column. A spaces the copy, badges and CTA more evenly. B squeezes the body copy against the badges and leaves a larger empty band at the bottom, so A edges it slightly.
